values: model point values, no prior range
grid: Zensus grid EPSG:3035, 100 m cells, keys "<x>_<y>" with x = floor(E / 100), y = floor(N / 100)
window: r = 0: the cell itself; r = 1: sums of the 3 × 3 neighbourhood (300 m); r = 2: 5 × 5 (500 m); the first window with at least minN buildings is used (rHs: the same, counted on nHs)

hs.basis: final energy incl. hot water at the typical level of measured consumption, gas on Hi; refHsMWh = living area (A_N / 1.2 × kappa, calibrated to Zensus 2022: data/zensus/living.json) × Heizspiegel mean of carrier and size class; bands with kappa < 0.5 left out
hs.typical: finHsMWh = typical level of measured consumption for the modelled demand (Loga et al. 2019, BBSR-Online 04/2019; Loga & Stein 2022, eceee, Model 2; js/consumption.js); ratioStd: the standard calculation; ratioAN12: standard calculation with living area A_N / 1.2
